text:
Lee: Quick sync - after launch customers flagged two regressions + one request: 1) inference logs missing request_ids for retries, 2) UI job-list pagination resets on refresh, 3) request: add per-tenant rate-limit view. Need to decide sprint scope.

Maya: Logs bug is causing customer support friction. Pagination is annoying but not blocking. Rate-limit view is a nice-to-have for enterprise customers.

Omar: Triage proposal: Lane A = logs + pagination if quick, Lane B = rate-limit view. Estimate: logs fix ~2 dev-days (includes logback config + deploy), pagination ~1 dev-day, rate-limit view ~4 dev-days + design.

Frank: Recommend 50% sprint capacity to lane A this week and flag rate-limit as next sprint backlog item. If logs fix is easy, we can push pagination too.

Lee: Agree. Owners: Omar -> logs, Maya -> pagination, Frank -> rate-limit epic. Ops-bot: can we do a canary for the logs change on one tenant?

ops-bot: Canary pipeline scheduled: version 2.3.6-canary -> tenant=alpha-corp -> monitor=24h.

Maya: I'll add acceptance: all retry requests must surface the original request_id and surface in the troubleshooting UI.

Omar: I'll open PR `fix/log-retry-ids` and include a short runbook for CS.

Frank: I'll create the rate-limit epic and wire it to the roadmap; deprioritizing unless 2 more customers ask.

Lee: Decision: ship logs hotfix canary in 24h, add pagination if PR lands early, rate-limit deferred. Sync tomorrow 10am if blockers.

Maya: :thumbsup:

Omar: starting on PR now.
